newsitem.title: USA: Interpore Q4 preliminary sales top $5.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Interpore Q4 preliminary sales top $5.3 mln.

text.p: Interpore International Inc on Tuesday said it expects fourth quarter sales to rise to a record $5.3 million, a 27 percent rise from $4.2 million in the year-ago quarter.

In a statement, Interpore said sales of orthopaedic products, primarily Pro Osteon bone graft substitute, rose 64 percent to a record $3.3 million for the quarter compared with $2.0 million one year ago.
"The continued increase in Pro Osteon sales demonstrates growing market acceptance of our core technology products," said David Mercer, chief executive officer.

Fourth quarter sales of OEM porous hydroxyapatite products fell 12 percent to $270,000 from $308,000 one year ago. Sales of oral/maxillofacial (dental) products were $1.7 million, down six percent from $1.8 million last year.

For the full year, net sales rose 16 percent to a record $19.9 million from $17.1 million in 1995. Orthopaedic product sales increased 47 percent to $11.7 million, compared with sales of $8.0 million. OEM product sales, including Pro Osteon for use in titanium spine cages, rose four percent to $1.11 million from $1.07 million in 1995. Dental product sales for 1996 were $7.1 million versus $8.1 million last year.
